name: testConnect
description: One-shot probe: spawn a TRANSIENT NexusMcpHost from the given config, run the MCP initialize + tools/list handshake, return {success, tools, toolCount, serverName?, serverVersion?, error?}, and tear down. Mirrors the legacy chrome.send 'testMcpServer' route. Exposed on the panel WebUI bridge port too (alongside the worker port) so the Settings · MCP form can probe without going through chrome.send. The transient host is never registered with the bridge or persisted to prefs.

inputs.name: id
inputs.description: Server id. May be empty: the test only needs transport + url/command + secrets. The UI tests an unnamed server, reads `serverName` from the result, and names it before save.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Server launch config dict — transport, url/command/args/env, optional headers. PLAINTEXT secrets at this point (the test runs before encryption-on-save).
